doc: Image accuracy baselines and their exceptions (ADR 0047, ADR 0052). Measured by tools/bench/compare_direct.py --final [--sky | --candela] at 640x360 against the path tracer (modes 1, 3 and 4). Entries are keyed by name and mode; `realtime_frames` (default 64) is the real-time warm-up. A scene passes at flip + max(0.001, 5% of flip) mean FLIP and within 2% mean luminance, unless an exception names an open backlog item: tools/scripts/check_repo.py fails once that item is done, so the exception goes with its bug. 'gate': the pre-push gate runs it (tests/CMakeLists.txt); 'benchmark': run by hand in a release build when lighting, the denoiser or the upscaler changes.

exceptions.why: the blended dirt decal is masked at 0.5 in real time, covered stochastically by the path tracer
Candela step 1b: samples keep the radiance they were chosen with; spatial reuse off (brighter than the reference, inside candela.AC7's 10% leak bound)
Candela step 1b: samples keep the radiance they were chosen with; spatial reuse off

motion_trail.doc: Bistro noon's motion trail (tests/motion_trail.py: the final image at 1280x720 after 30 frames of a 1.5 m strafe, against a still camera at the same pose; VCH-069, candela spec). GI off passes within `noise` of its measured trail; Candela within the owner's `margin` over GI off's measured trail with the same upscaler, unless an exception names an open backlog item (check_repo.py fails once it is done). Two still images 60 frames apart already differ by 0.017 (0.027 with MetalFX).

exceptions.why: Candela step 1b: the gather's noise outlasts the denoiser's history, and revealed surfaces start from one noisy sample (+0.042 over GI off; the margin allows +0.015)
